x_note: Heterogeneous v0.1 continuum: cloud-01/fog-01 support the single v0.1 D-Node ABI (datum-dnode/0, ADR-0003), host-independent; mist-arm-gateway-01 is a restricted/lightweight element that cannot host any D-Code under the current ABI (empty capability set is legal, distinct from an unrecognised-ABI-token violation). Real cross-crate mapper fixture, same discipline as dgraph.smart-sentinel-lab.json.
